status: P1 of docs/PU12_DEVELOPMENT.md: the vehicle and its equipment, every value cited. Research: docs/research/PU12_RESEARCH_2026-10.md

sources.notes: ČSLA Del-25-53/1 (1982), figures via valka_pu12: the equipment plan and workplaces
Equipment lists and dimensions (from PVOV-2-3, TMNO 24-65-86)
NVA: ASPD-U blocks, radios and nets, mast, navigation errors
Crew numbers, ASPD-U data, deployment norms (later build: its radios are not used)
Veteran: seats in the photographs, ДХ and ФР blocks

crew.source: ru_pu12_text (командир боевого расчёта), csla_pu12_manual via valka_pu12 (velitel baterie)
crew.notes: Works in the post but is not one of its four numbers (armforc_pu12 and shilka_narod list four). His seat can be empty: an NPC battery commander runs the battery from outside.

crew.source: ru_pu12_text (командир отделения управления, No. 1), valka_pu12 (velitel družstva)
ru_pu12_text (оператор-планшетист, No. 2), valka_pu12 (pátrač-kreslič), shilka_narod (the operator's place at the IT-45)

chassis.value: BTR-60PB (BTR-60PU base without the turret), 8x8, amphibious

length_m.notes: armforc_pu12 gives 7.56 m; ru_pu12_text 7.7 m is the later BTR-80 build.

height_m.source: valka_pu12 (the largest height; 2.055 m to the top of the armour)
height_m.notes: Another valka_pu12 post gives 3.32 m overall.

combat_mass_kg.notes: 10 500 kg in another valka_pu12 post; armforc_pu12 11 t; shilka_narod 12 t.

engines.value: 2 x GAZ-49B petrol, 66 kW (90 PS) each at 3600 rpm; the left drives axles 2 and 4, the right axles 1 and 3 and the winch

deploy_time_s.source: ru_pu12_text (full deployment without wire lines: by day at most 18 min), armforc_pu12 (18 min)

deploy_time_with_wire_s.source: ru_pu12_text (with four wire lines laid to 500 m: by day at most 25 min, at night 30)

description.value: RPS-M cabinet (telecode transmitter R, receiver P, synchronisation S; S23-1 block), SSP follow-up drive (220N), DTP parallax sensor, IT-45 screen, ДХ (DCh) characteristics keypad, DI marker, ФР deflection block, UO power
description.source: flak11 (PU12-0, from the GDR handbook), valka_pu12, shilka_narod

targets.source: ru_pu12_text (information on a hundred targets, numbers 00-99)

take_off_time_s.source: ru_pu12_text (semi-automatic take-off and sending of one target: 2-3 s)

speed_step_mps.source: ru_pu12_text (shown as a vector, 0 to 787.5 m/s)

display_scales_m.source: ru_pu12_text (scales 35, 50, 100 km); flak11 (two scales, to 100 and 50 km); the ФР block's three-position scale switch in shilka_narod's photograph

radar_cable_m.source: flak11 (PU12-0: up to 300 m from the radar), ru_pu12_text

max_power_w.source: ru_pu12_text (the equipment draws at most 2.5 kW)

radios.net: air picture (designation net no. 2, the plotters)
command of the battery (designations to its launchers by voice)
reception of the regiment's automated fire control (telecode)

mast_height_m.source: flak11 (PU12-1: 16 m telescopic mast); valka_pu12 (a ČSLA caption: the signalman extends the 16 m mast)
mast_height_m.notes: armforc_pu12 and shilka_narod give 6 m. The tier-1 figure is used. Guyed at two heights in the combat position (csla_pu12_manual).

description.value: GAK (1G13M) gyro direction indicator and its control panel, KP-4 coordinate and course computer, distance sensor, VO (1T25) orientation telescope, PAB-2 aiming circle

kp4_error_fraction.source: flak11 (PU12-0: at most 1 % of the distance travelled)

designation_error_deg.source: flak11 (PU12-0: working with the navigation equipment, up to 5 degrees in azimuth)

generator_set.value: AB-1-P/30-M1 petrol set, 220 V 50 Hz, with the URB control unit; set on the ground behind the vehicle in the combat position

on_the_move.value: G-290B generator driven by the engine

status_boards.value: IT-1 (at the squad leader) and IT-2 (at the commander's desk): the units' state, the vehicles' activity, ammunition

validation_scenarios.name: Deployment norm
validation_scenarios.expected_outcome: At most 18 min by day, 20 at night
